description: A swap whose SOURCE rect has zero width on one axis and zero height on the other. There is no ratio to take, so that axis falls back to a scale of 1 -- not to an infinity, which would smear a single texel across the whole layer, and not to 0, which would collapse the sampling to a point. The two parts split the degenerate axis between them so a fallback applied to the wrong axis cannot pass. A zero-area rect is reachable from a decompose pass on a one-pixel sliver, so this is a real input rather than a hypothetical one.
